_comment: Dev topology SSOT (fe-dev-stack-launcher, 2026-06-14). Single source for the local dev API gateway: each backend surface's path prefixes, default port, uvicorn ASGI factory, and whether it carries a WebSocket. Consumed by BOTH vite.config.ts (server.proxy entries — the local gateway) AND scripts/dev-stack.mjs (the one-command orchestrator that spawns the backends from the host venv; it reads key/port/uvicornFactory, not the prefixes). Keeping it here once prevents port/prefix drift between the proxy and the launcher. pathPrefixes is an ARRAY because one ASGI app can mount several top-level prefixes (dev-environment-contract-parity, 2026-08-01): the headless app serves /headless, /health AND /report-automation, and the former singular key silently dropped the latter two — /report-automation/stats 404'd in dev and the report-request cancel button could never succeed. tests/test_apps_web_scaffold.py::TestDevStackProxyCoversEveryBackendPrefix derives the required set from the backend route tables and fails if this file misses any. Per-surface target host:port is env-overridable at dev time via VITE_{SESSION,HEADLESS,PLATFORM}_API_TARGET. Backends bind 127.0.0.1.
